whyVikendly.title: Why Vikendly?

totalPrice.title: Total price, no surprises
totalPrice.text: The price you see is the price for the whole stay, with nothing added.

pricePerPerson.title: Price per person
pricePerPerson.text: See right away what the weekend costs each person in your group.

noiseRules.title: Clear party rules
noiseRules.text: Every house clearly says whether parties are allowed or it is a quiet house.

verified.title: Verified houses
verified.text: When we visit a house, it gets a “Verified in person” badge. That way you always know what we have seen with our own eyes.

directContact.title: We arrange it for you
directContact.text: Send a request, we check the dates with the owner and get back to you.

whyVikendly.intro: We are not another huge listings site. We pick fewer houses, check them in person and show everything you need to know before you go.

step1.title: Search
step1.text: Pick a destination, dates and guests and see the total price instantly.

step2.title: Send a request
step2.text: We check the dates with the owner and call you back.

step3.title: Enjoy
step3.text: Pack up and go. No hidden costs when you arrive.
